execution_condition: runs ONLY if the primary discovery satisfies ALL critical gates

primary_parameters_frozen.entry: next 1h bar OPEN strictly after decision_time

neighbourhood.stability_requirement: one-factor-at-a-time sign-of-net-expectancy only; >= 60% positive else PARAMETER_FRAGILITY

forbidden_during_robustness: re-running the primary with modified parameters
reporting any sub-cell as ARC-01's result
using robustness outcomes to reset the preregistration
independently_confirmed: no clause permits selecting the best neighbour; R5 states the primary parameters are NOT changed and the neighbour best cell must never be reported as the ARC-01 result
